exposure: Preoperative audiovisual tour of the operating room
preoperative audiovisual information on the operation theater environment
cohort: 120 patients aged 18-60 years, ASA class I-II, admitted for infra-umbilical surgery under spinal anesthesia (excluding cesarean section).
finding: Preoperative audiovisual tours of the operating room effectively reduce perioperative anxiety and stabilize heart rate in patients undergoing elective surgery under spinal anesthesia.
